definitions.noise.volatile_value: A frequently changing count, rotating item, or telemetry value that does not alter an offer, obligation, availability, or required action.
definitions.noise.time_or_build_metadata: A generated-at, refreshed-at, deployment, cache, export, or build marker that does not alter the page's user-facing state.
definitions.noise.structure_or_order: A reordering or layout-only change that preserves the same user-facing items and meaning.
